demo.question: How much vegetation did the Tesla Gigafactory Berlin lose since 2019?

plan.explanation: Vegetation (NDVI) change over Tesla Gigafactory Berlin-Brandenburg: 2019 vs the last 12 months.

steps: Searching Sentinel-2 scenes over Tesla Gigafactory Berlin-Brandenburg, 2019-01-01 to 2019-12-31
Ranking 100 before scenes by clear pixels inside Tesla Gigafactory Berlin-Brandenburg, then re-checking the best for haze
Reading 4 bands at 10 m for 2019-04-02 (100% clear, 1% bright/hazy)
Searching Sentinel-2 scenes over Tesla Gigafactory Berlin-Brandenburg, 2025-11-21 to 2026-11-21
Ranking 88 after scenes by clear pixels inside Tesla Gigafactory Berlin-Brandenburg, then re-checking the best for haze
Reading 4 bands at 10 m for 2025-11-21 (100% clear, 6% bright/hazy)
demo.answer: Between 2019-04-02 and 2025-11-21, Tesla Gigafactory Berlin-Brandenburg lost about 132 ha and gained about 1 ha of vegetation. Mean NDVI went from 0.66 to 0.41.
